requirements.note: Sorted by last name, with letter sections and a right-hand index plus a 'Jump to Letter' menu. But index jumps land in the wrong place: M went to J/K, S to P, Z to T, and B landed mid-section. Choosing M from the jump menu while at P did not move the list at all.
Filters live by name, company, formatted or digits-only phone, and email. Has a 'No Results' state, and clearing restores the full list. The search text also comes back after a relaunch.
Grouped details screen with name, company, phone, email and birthday. Phone and email are blue and look tappable.
'Add to / Remove from Favorites' row on the details screen. A Favorites section of full rows sits at the top of the list and updates right away.
Add sheet with all five fields. Done stays disabled for empty or whitespace-only names, with a hint. Edit uses the same form, and changes show at once. The phone field accepted letters.
Swipe-to-delete on list rows (deletes at once), and Delete Contact on the details screen with a confirmation alert.
Added, edited, deleted and unfavorited contacts all survived relaunch.

bugs: Section index and jump menu scroll to the wrong letter, usually short of the target (M→K, S→P, Z→T)
Jump menu choice 'M' while at P did nothing
While searching, two section indexes are drawn side by side (the app's own and a second, smaller one)
Sticky section header overlaps the text of the row scrolling beneath it (e.g. 'J' drawn over 'Priya Johnson')
Search text is restored after relaunch, so the app can open on a filtered or 'No Results' list
tells: Large title never collapses on scroll. The list sits in a fixed frame under the header and is hard-clipped above the bottom search bar instead of scrolling under translucent bars.
Hand-drawn swipe action: a grey rounded row with a red pill 'Delete' button, not the system trailing swipe action
Custom section index scales with Dynamic Type until it overflows and is cut off at the largest size; the system index stays compact
Generic grey person glyph instead of an initials avatar on the details screen
At the largest text size, email breaks mid-word ('elena.alvarez@e / xample.com')
Pull past the top stretches only the list region; the title does not move with it
A.scroll: Smooth, with no blank rows or pop-in, and scroll position is kept when returning from a contact. But the list scrolls in a clipped box under a large title that never collapses, and index jumps undershoot, so it feels less like a system list.

requirements.note: Sorted by last name, with letter sections and a compact right-hand index (★ A–Z) that jumps exactly to the tapped letter.
Filters live by name, company, formatted or digits-only phone, and email. Shows 'No Results for …', and clearing restores the full list.
Initials avatar, name, company, Call/Email buttons, Phone and Email rows in the accent colour with arrow affordances, and Birthday when known.

Add/Remove from Favorites on the details screen works, and favorites get their own section at the top. But it is a horizontal avatar carousel showing about 4 of 31, so most favorites need a sideways scroll.
Add/Edit form with labelled fields. Save is disabled until a non-blank first or last name exists, with a hint. Cancel with changes asks 'Discard changes?'. Edits show at once.
Swipe-to-delete on rows, and Delete Contact on the details screen with a confirmation.
Added, edited, favorited and deleted contacts all survived relaunch; the contact count updates.

bugs: After dismissing search, the first tap on a contact row only highlights it and does not open the details screen; a second tap is needed (reproduced twice)
Delete confirmation on the details screen pops up pointing at the avatar at the top of the screen, not at the Delete button
tells: Swipe Delete button is purple (the accent colour), not destructive red, and overlaps the section index
Purple accent and pastel gradient initials avatars everywhere give it a custom-themed look
An extra '320 contacts · All Contacts' row at the top of the list
Favorites as a horizontal avatar carousel instead of list rows
At the largest text size the section index overlaps the favorites carousel names, and the search field grows into a giant pill
Title starts inline on launch and turns large only after interaction (inconsistent large-title state)
B.scroll: Feels native: content scrolls under translucent bars with the edge blur, the large title collapses, flings and pulls behave normally, index jumps are exact, and scroll position is kept on returning from a contact.

why: B's list behaves like a real iOS list: exact index jumps, a collapsing large title, and content scrolling under translucent bars. Its details screen is richer (avatar, Call/Email, birthday). A has a more literal Favorites section, but its index jumps are unreliable, it shows a duplicate index while searching, its section headers overlap rows, and its large title is frozen in a clipped list. B's flaws (first tap ignored after closing search, a purple swipe-delete button, the favorites carousel) are smaller.
